local function FetchRaw(url)
    if type(request) == "function" then
        local ok, req = pcall(request, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        if ok and type(req) == "table" and req.StatusCode == 200
            and type(req.Body) == "string" and #req.Body >= 100 then
            return true, req.Body
        end
    end
    local ok, src = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)
    if ok and type(src) == "string" and #src >= 100 then
        return true, src
    end
    return false, nil
end

local function CacheBust(url)
    local sep = string.find(url, "?", 1, true) and "&" or "?"
    return url .. sep .. "cb=" .. tostring(os.time()) .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
end

local function FetchApiRaw(apiPath)
    if type(request) ~= "function" then return false, nil end
    local ok, req = pcall(request, {
        Url = "https://api.github.com/repos/xulfo/OxideUiLibary2/contents/" .. apiPath,
        Method = "GET",
        Headers = {
            ["Accept"]     = "application/vnd.github.raw+json",
            ["User-Agent"] = "hacking-bros",
        },
    })
    if ok and type(req) == "table" and req.StatusCode == 200
        and type(req.Body) == "string" and #req.Body >= 100 then
        return true, req.Body
    end
    return false, nil
end

local function FetchFresh(url, marker, minBytes, apiPath)
    minBytes = minBytes or 100
    for attempt = 1, 3 do
        local target = attempt == 1 and url or CacheBust(url)
        local ok, body = FetchRaw(target)
        if ok and #body >= minBytes and (marker == nil or string.find(body, marker, 1, true)) then
            return true, body, attempt
        end
        if attempt < 3 then task.wait(1) end
    end
    if apiPath then
        local ok, body = FetchApiRaw(apiPath)
        if ok and #body >= minBytes and (marker == nil or string.find(body, marker, 1, true)) then
            return true, body, 4
        end
    end
    return false, nil, 4
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function LibraryUsable(lib)
    return type(lib) == "table"
        and type(lib.CreateWindow) == "function"
        and lib.ChatFree == true
end

local function LoadLibrary()
    local cached = cacheGet("lib")
    if LibraryUsable(cached) then
        print("[HackingBros] Library reused from cache (v" .. tostring(cached.Version or "?") .. ").")
        return cached
    end

    local ok, source, attempt = FetchFresh(CFG.LIB_URL, LIB_MARKER, 50000, "UiLibary/Libary.lua")
    if not ok then
        error("[HackingBros] Could not fetch the CURRENT UI library — CDN stale. Re-run in a few seconds.", 0)
    end

    local chunk, compileErr = loadstring(source)
    if not chunk then error("[HackingBros] Library compile error: " .. tostring(compileErr), 0) end
    local ok2, lib = pcall(chunk)
    if not ok2 then error("[HackingBros] Library execution error: " .. tostring(lib), 0) end
    if not LibraryUsable(lib) then
        error("[HackingBros] Library loaded but it is NOT the current chat-free build. Re-run.", 0)
    end

    cacheSet("lib", lib)
    if attempt >= 4 then
        print("[HackingBros] CDN stale — pulled fresh from API fallback.")
    elseif attempt > 1 then
        print("[HackingBros] CDN stale — refetched (attempt " .. attempt .. ").")
    end
    print("[HackingBros] Library v" .. tostring(lib.Version or "?") .. " ready.")
    return lib
end

local function LoadGameScript(lib, scriptName)
    local content = cacheGet("script:" .. scriptName)
    local fromCache = content ~= nil
    if not fromCache then
        local url = CFG.SCRIPTS_BASE .. scriptName
        local ok, body = FetchFresh(url, nil, 2000, "scripts/" .. scriptName)
        if not ok then error("[HackingBros] Failed to download game script: " .. scriptName, 0) end
        content = body
        cacheSet("script:" .. scriptName, content)
    end

    local fullSource = "Library = _G.HackingBrosLib;\n" .. content
    local chunk, compileErr = loadstring(fullSource)
    if not chunk then
        error("[HackingBros] Game script compile error (" .. scriptName .. "): " .. tostring(compileErr), 0)
    end
    local ok2, err = pcall(chunk)
    if not ok2 then
        error("[HackingBros] Game script runtime error (" .. scriptName .. "): " .. tostring(err), 0)
    end
    return fromCache
end

local themeStamp = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function ApplyTheme(node)
    local ok, class = pcall(function() return node.ClassName end)
    if not ok then return end

    if class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox" then
        pcall(function()
            local t = node.Text
            if type(t) == "string" and #t > 0 then
                local n = RewriteArcText(t)
                if n ~= t then node.Text = n end
            end
            if not themeStamp[node] then
                local txt = node.Text or ""
                if #txt <= 18 then
                    node.TextColor3 = THEME.White
                else
                    node.TextColor3 = THEME.Gray
                end
                themeStamp[node] = true
            end
        end)

    elseif class == "ImageLabel" or class == "ImageButton" then
        pcall(function()
            local img = node.Image
            if IsArcLogo(img) then
                node.Visible = false
                node.Image = ""
                pcall(function() node:Destroy() end)
                return
            end
            if not themeStamp[node] then
                if node.ImageColor3 ~= nil then
                    local c = node.ImageColor3
                    if c.R > 0.85 and c.G > 0.85 and c.B > 0.85 then
                        node.ImageColor3 = THEME.Red
                    end
                end
                themeStamp[node] = true
            end
        end)

    elseif class == "Frame" or class == "CanvasGroup" or class == "ScrollingFrame" then
        pcall(function()
            if themeStamp[node] then return end
            local bg = node.BackgroundColor3
            if bg == nil then return end
            if bg.R < 0.15 and bg.G < 0.15 and bg.B < 0.15 then
                node.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Bg
            elseif bg.R < 0.30 and bg.G < 0.30 and bg.B < 0.30 then
                node.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Element
            elseif bg.R > 0.75 and bg.G > 0.75 and bg.B > 0.75 then
                node.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Red
            end
            themeStamp[node] = true
        end)

    elseif class == "UIStroke" then
        pcall(function()
            if themeStamp[node] then return end
            node.Color = THEME.Border
            themeStamp[node] = true
        end)
    end

    local ok2, kids = pcall(function() return node:GetChildren() end)
    if ok2 then
        for _, child in ipairs(kids) do ApplyTheme(child) end
    end
end
